purpose: Phase N1, the free-model shakedown (plan section 5.0c): the candidate configuration Phase N2 runs on paid models (deploy/production-settings.json with strategist v7, card verification v4, scene profile v3, brief contract v4 and writer v5), with every model-backed stage on a free OpenRouter model. Applied only to the scratch database atelier_shakedown; never to the working copy or production (test_privacy_routing.py checks that no configuration of record names a free model). The free models were chosen on 23 October from GET /api/v1/models: structured output (response_format and structured_outputs) supported, a context of at least 131,000 tokens, answering a strict json_schema request on the Client key; two families, so the verifier, the reviewer and the categoriser read another model's work as they do in production. Phase NP (24 October, NP.X1): the content pack's finisher and repair on the first free model and its check on the second, the same families; checked on 24 October from GET /api/v1/models (structured outputs, context of at least 131,000 tokens). A free finisher is expected to fail its contract, and the stages after it then run on a canned answer (storage_cli pack-canned), recorded as pipeline path, not model quality.
apply: python -m backend_pipeline.storage_cli settings apply --file deploy/shakedown-settings.json --actor <approver email> (on atelier_shakedown only)
